findings.title: Ten COMPAT-X event-evolution gates are red since PDC-X; they are green at the activation pin
findings.evidence: Re-running the 53 failures of the regression run in short-path detached checkouts: 52 fail at 19d552bee, the same 52 at fa6ff1c96, 40 at the pin (logs/failing_nodes_at_{head,fa6,pin}.log, attribution_of_regression_failures.json). The 12 that are red only since PDC-X are the 10 gates tests/qualification/compat_x/test_compat_x_event_evolution_r3_p0_gates.py x4 and ..._r3_r1_gates.py x6 plus the 2 inventory tests of F-07. The compat_x messages: 'unclassified persistence append intergrax/runtime/security/security_audit_trail.py:213 self._evidence.append', 'unclassified runtime event reader intergrax/runtime/security/security_audit_trail.py:198 append RuntimeEvent(...)', 'canonical production persistence bypass count 1 (expected 0)', 'probe K: production gate must pass before unknown injection'.
findings.impact: the new evidence-plane security audit trail (PDC-D6-R020) appends canonical RuntimeEvents from a site the COMPAT-X persistence classification does not know; the COMPAT-X closed-world gates are red on the baseline. The first audit did not run tests/qualification/compat_x, tests/unit/agent_distribution or tests/unit/memory, so this was missed there (coverage correction, not a delta effect: identical at fa6ff1c96).
findings.disposition: TEST_ONLY_FIX / classification by the COMPAT-X owner (add the site to the persistence classification registries); not a product change; to be read together with F-06/F-07 as 'CI contexts red after merge'

findings.title: The tenant-bound memory guard applies only to the shipped UserProfileManagerMemoryCapability
findings.evidence: default_memory_control_plane.py:_assert_identity_tenant_is_bound_tenant is guarded by isinstance(capability, UserProfileManagerMemoryCapability) and reads the private manager._tenant_id through bound_tenant_id. Probe Q1 (logs/addendum_1_probes.results.json): shipped wrapper bound to tenant-A refuses tenant-B ('denied'), also a whitespace variant 'tenant-A ' ('denied'); a duck-typed capability object (not the shipped wrapper) accepts a foreign-tenant identity (NO_RAISE). The guard covers remember, recall, apply_memory_supersession, forget and reconcile for USER scope; TASK and SESSION scopes are not part of it.
findings.impact: closes FINDING-6 for the shipped composition; an alternative capability implementation (the Protocol allows one) is not protected by the plane.
findings.disposition: ROUTE_TO_IA-D2; recommend a protocol-level tenant property instead of the isinstance gate

findings.title: The LLM profile pin and the required-feature check are opt-in; no production caller uses either
findings.evidence: Probe Q5: git grep at 19d552bee finds no non-test caller passing required_llm_features= to resolve_llm_adapter and none passing llm_profile_source= to AgentPlatformAdminService. admin_service: without a source, _current_llm_profile_digest returns None, the built revision is unpinned and _require_pinned_llm_profile returns immediately for a revision with llm_profile_digest None; with a pinned revision and no source composed, activation raises RuntimeActivationConflict (fail closed, tested). resolve_optional_llm_adapter / create_adapter_for_routing_evaluation take no required features. Positive probes: Q2 an adapter without any declaration is refused (LLMCapabilityMismatchError); Q4 the profile digest changes with model, options, fallback profiles and routing hint; Q3 unknown or upper-case feature names are rejected, JSON round-trip is stable, duplicates are kept.
findings.impact: FINDING-9 and FINDING-10 are closed at the component level; they hold for a host only if the host composes llm_profile_source and passes AgentContract.required_llm_features (same pattern as F-04).
findings.disposition: ROUTE_TO_IA-D1/D3; orchestrator to decide whether host composition is a PDC-X claim

findings.title: A COMPAT-X schema-id gate fails in the long combined run but passes in isolation
findings.evidence: tests/qualification/compat_x/test_compat_x_event_evolution_r3_p0_gates.py::test_cx_r3_p0_q2_inventory_schema_ids_match_registry failed in the combined 268-file run ('inventory/registry schema_id mismatch: [platform.security.defense_blocked.v1, platform.security.encryption_denied...') and passed when its file was run with the other failing files in a fresh process (not in the 52 failures at 19d552bee). Cause not isolated; the global payload-schema registry is extended at import time by several test and product modules (security_audit_trail registers security.audit_entry.v1 with extension=True).
findings.impact: order-dependent result of a global-registry gate; the suite result depends on collection order.
